decisions.reason: As a close-to-core sensor module launched only recently in a growing, R&D-intensive firm with slack and a broad modular platform, it is likely to be retained while demand information accumulates.
Its dedicated product page and fit with the firm's established industrial I/O architecture suggest performance is at least near aspiration, so management would likely keep it.
A solid state relay module uses existing capabilities and complements the installed base, making it a low-risk extension that a growing firm would usually continue.

Although somewhat more solution-oriented and therefore more uncertain than the core modules, it still builds on existing sensing and monitoring capabilities, so the firm would likely keep it unless early sales clearly miss aspirations.
